title: 第1章 被猪谋杀第2章 穿越没面子

第001章 被猪谋杀
一轮旭日缓缓升起，耀眼的金光照耀在大地之上，使得大地之上一片金黄。
天地间的某处，一个沼泽里不断的泛着绿色的气泡，空气中一缕缕金黄色的气流不断涌入气泡之中，诡异无比。
“太虚之力，哈哈，我终于出来了。”恐怖而略显沙哑的声音响起，一道黑影闪出，消失在天地之间。仔细一看，竟然是一头猪。
————————————————————西安市的某个小区里，一名年约十七岁的少年静静地站在窗前眺望着远方。少年名叫岳雨，身高约一米七三，身材略显消瘦，他面容清秀，给人一种强烈的亲和力，表面看你会觉得他很纯真，但你仔细一看他的眼睛，便会改变之前的想法，因为他的眼神之中透露着浓浓的猥琐。“今天天气不错，待会去华山转转。”岳雨轻吸着清新的空气，心情倍感舒畅。
咚！咚！咚！
“小雨，起床了吗？”外面一个长相普通的中年妇女轻敲着门问道。
岳雨听出了那是房东阿姨的声音便说道：“阿姨，我起来了。”随即急忙把床头的一本色情的小说塞到了枕头下，然后淡然地走到门前
“阿姨，有什么事吗？”岳雨隐约猜到了她的来意。
“小雨，你应该知道阿姨来找你是为何了吧？”房东看着岳雨，神情有些不悦，因为岳雨已经欠了她三个月的房租了。
“咳，阿姨，你也知道我的情况，再过几天我一定全部把房租付清。”岳雨故作可怜的望着房东，但房东显然不吃这一套，神色坚定，“小雨，你的情况我知道，但你都推拖了三个月了，这次不能再拖了。”房东了解岳雨的处境，同情岳雨才将房租这件事拖到了现在。
“阿姨，你宽容大度，善良体贴，房租就再缓上几天吧，过几天我家那老头子会给我送钱的，到时候一定一次付清。”岳雨劝说着，见房东神色有些犹豫，便微微一喜。然后凭借他那三寸不烂之舌费了半个小时才把房东说服。
房东叹息一声便离开了，留下岳雨一个人在那皱眉苦思。“那老头子也真是的，不就是把他那小绿珠吃了吗，犯得着这样吗。”岳雨走回房间坐到床上嘀咕着，没办法交房租，心里也有些发愁。
岳雨从小无父无母，从他记事起就是孤零零的一人，记得五岁那年，自己坐在墙头，随后一个身穿破布衣的邋遢老人走了过来。
“小朋友，我看你印膛有缕缕金光闪耀，显然是一个大气运者，将来必定是个大人物，跟着爷爷走，爷爷以后照顾你，供你上学好不？”老者带着和蔼的笑容看着岳雨，神色有些激动。
当时岳雨还是一个天真无邪的孩子，听了老者的话后便狠狠的点了点头，之后便高兴的跟着老者走了。若是当时是现在的自己，肯定会把他当成神经病一脚踢飞。
当时他还没名字，老者不久便给他起名叫岳雨，之后便供岳雨吃住和学习。
就在三个月前，岳雨发现一个糖果盒里装着一个绿色的珠子，他没有多想以为那是糖果，便拿起来就吃了，老头子回家后得知绿珠被岳雨吃了，便丢给岳雨几千块钱然后把他赶出了家。岳雨到现在都感觉有些莫名其妙，搞不懂老头子为何因为自己吃了一个珠子就把自己赶出来了。
“还是去华山转转吧，也好放松下心情。”岳雨不再想房租的事，他准备过几天找老头子去要。关上门，岳雨便朝楼下走去，此时他口袋里也就一百多块钱了，到街边的饭馆随便吃了点便乘车驶向了华山。
坐在车里，岳雨从口袋里拿出了老头子给自己买的苹果手机，给自己的死党萧晨打了过去。

“喂，小雨，你怎么还没来啊，我等了你半天了。”还未开口，电话里传来了萧晨那略显厚重的声音“和房东说了些事耽误了，你到华山了？我刚才都有些不想来了，好了，你在那等我，我半个小时就到。”岳雨说完便挂了电话。
半小时之后，岳雨便来到了华山，看着周围竟然没有一个人影，便有些疑惑。
“喂，你在哪呢？”岳雨打电话给萧晨问道。“小雨，你来了啊，我现在在华山之颠，原本打算在下面等你来着，可是刚才天空之上竟然突然裂开了一道缝，一个散发着黄色光芒的东西掉在了华山之巅上，太不可思议了。”萧晨解释道。
岳雨听了后一愣，“我靠，你小子玄幻小说看多了吧，胡说什么啊，解释也得找个像样的理由吧，我还没傻。”岳雨才不信他说的话，因为那也太惊奇与荒诞了。
“小雨，我说的是真的，现在所有人都在这里呢，下面应该也没多少人吧？”萧晨问道。
岳雨听着他的语气觉得他并不像在开玩笑，而这里也确实没有一个人，便信了几分。
是真是假到了华山之巅就知道了，岳雨没有多想便踏上石阶向上走去。
走了大约五分钟后，岳雨皱起了眉，看着四周，还是一个人也没有。“不应该啊，怎么会一个人也没有？难道都在华山之巅上？”岳雨微微有些奇怪，他感觉这里这里的气氛与以往好像有些不同，感觉阴森森的。
眼前只能往上走，不久，岳雨便到了华山之巅，看着周围，岳雨暗骂了一声“靠！这死小子竟然耍我。”此时，周围还是一个人影也没有，没有鸟虫鸣叫，没有风声，一片寂静，甚至静的有些可怕。
岳雨不自然的打了个寒颤，华山作为出名的旅游胜地，来此旅游的人多不胜数，还从来没有出现过周围围一个人影也没有。
岳雨此刻有些害怕，拿起手机准备给萧晨打电话询问一番，可是一看手机，没信号！岳雨此刻有些慌了，手机偏偏这时没有信号。周围美丽的风景在死一般的寂静之下，带给岳雨的不是舒畅愉悦，而是一种渗人的阴森。
岳雨此刻哪敢在这里停留，待他准备离开时，却听到了一个声音。
“哼，哼，哼。”猪的声音响起。
岳雨寻着声音望去，不远处，竟然是出现了一头猪。岳雨愣住了，在这里看到人不奇怪，奇怪的是周围没有一个人，而此刻不远处一头猪正站在自己的不远处看着自己。
仔细的一看，岳雨瞪大了眼睛，一脸惊恐，因为岳雨看清楚了那头猪的眼睛，那眼睛竟然是血红色的！而且那眼神更是流露出一种恨意，一头猪眼神之中带着恨意，这说出去谁会相信？
猪就静静地站在原地一动不动，血红的双眼冷冷地看着岳雨。
“鬼啊！”岳雨惊恐的尖叫一声，转身就准备逃跑。可是下一刻岳雨的心就沉了下去，因为自己竟然不能动了，除了还能说话之外，身体竟然无法动弹，就仿佛被施展了定身术一般。
岳雨眼中充满不可置信之色，这一切也太过于惊奇了。那头猪嘴角动了动，像是再微笑，随即不理会岳雨惊恐的神色，便向着岳雨缓缓走了过去。
“你别过来，你是什么人？”岳雨慌了，身体都有些颤抖，也不管对方能不能听懂就大声喊道，同时心中苦笑，自己的问题有些傻，对方不是人，而是猪。毕竟他才十七岁，心境也不沉稳，此刻也冷静不下来。
见猪没有理会自己反而距离自己越来越近，岳雨便向那头猪求饶了，这或许也是有史以来第一次有人向猪求饶吧。

“猪兄，猪大哥，你我无冤无仇你可别杀我啊，我知道我是长的帅引起了你的嫉妒之心，可是你放心，只要你不杀我，我今天立刻回去整容！猪大哥，你身资魁梧，毛发有型，一双桃花眼更是天下万千少女的最爱，你......。”听了岳雨的话那头猪一个踉跄险些摔倒，这小子也太极品太自恋了吧？
猪实在听不下去了，身子一跃，竟然凌空扑向了岳雨，速度快的惊人，一息之间，便从数十米之远的地方来到了岳雨眼前。
“我靠，你这头丑猪，就算你杀了我也改变不了你丑陋的事实，长的丑不是你的错，但出来吓人就是你的不对了，你活在世上简直是一个祸害，我是你的话早就跳崖自杀了......”看那猪扑来，岳雨知道自己是凶多吉少了，话锋一转便大骂了起来。
猪没有理会岳雨这个极品人物，脑袋朝着岳雨的胸前一顶。岳雨只觉得一股巨力袭来，胸前猛的一痛，身体便被顶上了半空，向着身后的悬崖落去。
耳边呼呼的风声响起，岳雨此刻处于半醒半昏迷状态，他知道自己已经被猪给拱下了悬崖，无力地看了一眼下方，云雾缭绕，这高度摔下去必死无疑。
我不想死啊，我还有好多事情没做呢，我还是处男......岳雨不甘的在心里吼叫着，随后便失去了意识。
岳雨不知道的是，在自己的悬崖下方，地面竟然瞬间裂开，一个犹如眼眸般的巨大裂缝瞬间形成。裂缝之内漆黑的雾气高速旋转，一股恐怖的气息弥漫开来，将周围的飞禽走兽吓的浑身颤抖，匍匐在地。
不久，岳雨便落到了悬崖底，更是恰恰落入了裂缝之内。岳雨身影消失，随即裂缝也瞬间消失，地面恢复了原貌......

Chapter 001 Murdered by Pigs
A rising sun slowly rises, and the dazzling golden light shines on the earth, making the earth golden.
Somewhere between heaven and earth, a swamp is constantly filled with green bubbles, and strands of golden air flow in the air continue to pour into the bubbles, which is extremely weird.
"The power of Taixu, haha, I finally came out." A terrifying and slightly hoarse voice sounded, and a black shadow flashed out and disappeared between heaven and earth. Upon closer inspection, it turned out to be a pig.
——————————————————————In a certain community in Xi’an City, a boy of about seventeen years old stood quietly in front of the window and looked into the distance. The boy's name is Yue Yu. He is about 1.73 meters tall and slightly thin. He has a delicate face and gives people a strong affinity. On the surface, you will think that he is innocent, but if you take a closer look at his eyes, you will change your previous thoughts, because there is a strong sense of obscenity in his eyes. "The weather is nice today. Let's go to Huashan later." Yue Yu breathed in the fresh air and felt more comfortable.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
"Xiaoyu, are you up?" An ordinary-looking middle-aged woman knocked on the door and asked.
Yue Yu recognized the voice of the landlord's aunt and said: "Auntie, I'm up." Then he hurriedly stuffed a pornographic novel on the bedside under the pillow, and then walked to the door calmly.
"Auntie, what's the matter?" Yue Yu vaguely guessed her purpose.
"Xiao Yu, you should know why auntie came to see you, right?" The landlord looked at Yue Yu with a somewhat unhappy expression, because Yue Yu already owed her three months' rent.
"Ahem, Auntie, you also know my situation. I will definitely pay off all the rent in a few days." Yue Yu looked at the landlord pretending to be pitiful, but the landlord obviously did not accept this, and his expression was firm, "Xiaoyu, I know your situation, but you have been putting it off for three months, and you can't delay it anymore this time." The landlord understood Yue Yu's situation, and sympathized with Yue Yu for delaying the rent matter until now.
"Auntie, you are tolerant, kind and considerate. Please defer the rent for a few more days. My old man will give me money in a few days. I will pay it all in one lump sum." Yue Yu persuaded, seeing the landlord's hesitant expression, he was slightly happy. Then it took him half an hour to convince the landlord with his sharp tongue.
The landlord sighed and left, leaving Yue Yu alone, frowning and thinking. "Then the old man is serious. Didn't he just eat his little green bead? Can't he do this?" Yue Yu walked back to the room and sat on the bed, muttering, unable to pay the rent, and feeling a little worried.
Yue Yu had no father or mother since he was a child. He has been alone as long as he can remember. He remembers that when he was five years old, he was sitting on the wall, and then a sloppy old man wearing rags came over.
"Kid, I see that there are wisps of golden light shining in your seal. You are obviously a man of great luck. You will definitely be a big shot in the future. Follow grandpa. Grandpa will take care of you and support you in school, okay?" The old man looked at Yue Yu with a kind smile, looking a little excited.
At that time, Yue Yu was still an innocent child. After listening to the old man's words, he nodded fiercely, and then followed the old man happily. If it were me now, I would definitely kick him away as a lunatic.
He didn't have a name at that time, but the old man soon named him Yue Yu, and then provided Yue Yu with food, accommodation and education.
Just three months ago, Yue Yu found a green bead in a candy box. He didn't think much about it and thought it was candy, so he picked it up and ate it. When the old man came home and learned that the green bead had been eaten by Yue Yu, he threw thousands of dollars to Yue Yu and kicked him out of the house. Yue Yu still feels a little baffled and can't understand why the old man kicked him out just because he ate a bead.
"It's better to go to Huashan to relax and relax." YueYu no longer thought about the rent. He was going to ask the old man for it in a few days. After closing the door, Yue Yu walked downstairs. At this time, he only had more than a hundred yuan in his pocket. He went to a restaurant on the street to eat something and then drove to Huashan.
Sitting in the car, Yue Yu took out the iPhone the old man bought for him from his pocket and called his best friend Xiao Chen.
"Hey, Xiaoyu, why aren't you here yet? I've been waiting for you for a long time." Before he could speak, Xiao Chen's slightly thick voice came from the phone. "I talked to the landlord about something and I was delayed. Are you in Huashan? I didn't want to come just now. Okay, you wait for me there, I will be there in half an hour." After Yue Yu finished speaking, he hung up the phone.
Half an hour later, Yue Yu arrived at Huashan. Seeing that there was no one around, he felt a little confused.
"Hey, where are you?" Yue Yu called Xiao Chen and asked. "Xiaoyu, you're here. I'm at the top of Mount Huashan now. I originally planned to wait for you below, but just now a crack suddenly opened in the sky, and something emitting yellow light fell on the top of Mount Huashan. It's incredible." Xiao Chen explained.
Yue Yu was stunned after hearing this, "Holy shit, you kid has read too many fantasy novels. What nonsense are you talking about? You have to find a decent reason to explain. I'm not stupid yet." Yue Yu didn't believe what he said because it was too surprising and absurd.
"Xiao Yu, what I said is true. Everyone is here now. There shouldn't be many people down there, right?" Xiao Chen asked.
Listening to his tone, Yue Yu felt that he was not joking, and there was indeed no one here, so he believed it.
Whether it was true or not would be known when they reached the top of Mount Huashan. Yue Yu stepped on the stone steps and walked up without thinking too much.
After walking for about five minutes, Yue Yu frowned and looked around, but there was still no one there. "It shouldn't be. How come there's no one there? Are they all on the top of Mount Huashan?" Yue Yu was a little strange. He felt that the atmosphere here seemed a little different from before, and it felt eerie.
The only option was to go up. Soon, Yue Yu reached the top of Mount Huashan. Looking around, Yue Yu cursed inwardly, "Damn! This damn boy is trying to trick me." At this time, there was still no one around, no chirping of birds or insects, no sound of wind, it was quiet, even a bit scary.
Yue Yu shivered unnaturally. Huashan Mountain is a famous tourist destination. There are countless people traveling here, and there has never been a single person around.
Yue Yu was a little scared at this moment. She picked up her mobile phone and was about to call Xiao Chen to ask, but when she looked at her mobile phone, there was no signal! Yue Yu was a little panicked at this moment, but her cell phone had no signal at this time. The beautiful scenery around him, under the deathly silence, brought Yue Yu not comfort and joy, but a kind of penetrating gloom.
How could Yue Yu dare to stay here at this moment? When he was about to leave, he heard a voice.
"Hmph, hum, hum." The pig's voice sounded.
Yue Yu looked for the sound and saw a pig not far away. Yue Yu was stunned. It was not surprising to see people here. What was strange was that there was no one around, and at this moment, a pig was standing not far away from him and looking at him.
Taking a closer look, Yue Yu's eyes widened with a look of horror, because Yue Yu saw the pig's eyes clearly, and they turned out to be blood red! Moreover, the eyes revealed a kind of hatred. There was hatred in the eyes of a pig. Who would believe it?
Zhu just stood there quietly, motionless, looking at Yue Yu coldly with his blood-red eyes.
"Ghost!" Yue Yu screamed in horror, turned around and prepared to run away. But the next moment Yue Yu's heart sank, because he couldn't move. In addition to being able to speak, his body couldn't move, as if he had been cast on a body-holding technique.
Yue Yu's eyes were full of disbelief, all this was tooToo surprising. The corner of the pig's mouth moved, as if smiling again, and then ignored Yue Yu's frightened expression and walked slowly towards Yue Yu.
"Don't come here, who are you?" Yue Yu panicked, his body trembling a little, and he shouted loudly regardless of whether the other party could understand. At the same time, he smiled bitterly in his heart. His question was a bit silly. The other party was not a human, but a pig. After all, he is only seventeen years old, his mood is not stable, and he cannot calm down at the moment.
Seeing that the pig ignored him and got closer and closer to him, Yue Yu begged the pig for mercy. This was probably the first time in history that someone had begged a pig for mercy.
"Brother Pig, Brother Pig, you and I have no grievances, so don't kill me. I know I am handsome and have aroused your jealousy, but don't worry, as long as you don't kill me, I will go back for plastic surgery immediately today! Brother Pig, you With a tall body, stylish hair, and a pair of peach blossom eyes, you are the favorite of thousands of girls in the world. You..." After hearing Yue Yu's words, the pig stumbled and almost fell. Isn't this kid too awesome and too narcissistic?
Zhu couldn't stand listening anymore, so he jumped up and pounced on Yue Yu in the air. The speed was astonishing. In one breath, he came to Yue Yu from a distance of dozens of meters.
"Damn it, you ugly pig. Even if you kill me, you can't change the fact that you are ugly. It's not your fault that you are ugly, but it's your fault that you come out to scare people. You are a disaster in this world. If I were you, I would have committed suicide by jumping off the cliff..." Seeing the pig charging at him, Yue Yu knew that he was in danger, and started to curse as soon as the conversation changed.
Zhu ignored Yue Yu, a superb person, and pushed his head towards Yue Yu's chest. Yue Yu only felt a huge force coming, a sharp pain in his chest, and his body was lifted into the air and fell towards the cliff behind him.
The whistling wind sounded in his ears. Yue Yu was half awake and half comatose at the moment. He knew that he had been pushed off the cliff by the pig. He glanced feebly below. There were clouds and mist. If he fell from this height, he would definitely die.
I don't want to die, I still have a lot of things to do, I'm still a virgin... Yue Yu roared in his heart unwillingly, and then lost consciousness.
What Yue Yu didn't know was that beneath his cliff, the ground split open instantly, and a huge crack like an eye formed instantly. The dark mist inside the crack rotated at high speed, and a terrifying aura filled the air, making the surrounding birds and animals tremble and crawl to the ground.
Soon, Yue Yu fell to the bottom of the cliff, and fell right into the crack. Yue Yu's figure disappeared, and then the cracks disappeared instantly, and the ground returned to its original appearance...
